Kim / Samantha — pricing note.

We recommend the following structure to make procurement sign-off smoother and reduce unit-cost churn during ramp:
- Baseline: keep current committed units for months 1-2 post-signature.
- Ramp window (months 3-5): auto-scale buffer at +15% (billed at a blended tiered rate).
- Committed uplift: +30% starting month 6 with a 24-month term; include a 12-month price protection clause.

Proposed commercial ask: 8% discount on the incremental capacity for the first 12 months, then standard committed pricing. This lets CortexCloud validate usage and keeps cost predictable.

I'll attach a short pricing worksheet and the PRICING-LADDER tab (csv) for procurement.

Jordan Blake
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
